title: Eleven Words in March
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：treatment　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 treatment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① treatment began in March and finished in June, eleven weeks, and my mother said the treatment was not the hard part; the waiting in between was, and nobody puts that on a form. She asked the doctor to tell her the truth and he did, in eleven words.

The ② treatment she got was eleven weeks of the same thing, and she said a course of treatment is a timetable with a person inside it. What she minded was not the illness but the ③ treatment: the way the nurse spoke to the woman in the next bed, the way nobody knocked, and the way the forms came first.

There was no ④ treatment for the tiredness, which was the thing she had not expected and which lasted eleven months, and the treatment for it was sleep, and she said nobody warns you that the cure is longer than the illness. She ⑤ received treatment at the county hospital, forty minutes away, and my father drove her eleven times and never once came in, and she never once asked him why.

The ⑥ treatment of the water in the village had been done in 1931 and not touched since, and in 1974 the county tested it and found the thing that had made half the street ill, including, she thought, her. While she was ⑦ under treatment she wrote eleven letters about it, and the council answered one, and she said that was eleven more than they had answered in 1931.

In 1998 they ⑧ gave her the full treatment: her name on a door, a photograph in the hall, eleven people in a room and a speech. She hated it. The ⑨ treatment she remembered best, and the only one she ever thanked anybody for, was the eleven words the doctor had said in March, and she repeated them to me in 2003. The ⑩ treatment she had asked for, in the end, was not a cure at all: it was to be spoken to like a person, and she said most hospitals get that wrong and do not know it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 疗法；疗程（a course of treatment）
C. n. 对待（方式）；待遇
D. n. （水、废物等的）处理；净化加工
E. 固定搭配：receive / undergo treatment 接受治疗
F. 固定搭配：under treatment 在接受治疗中
G. 固定搭配：treatment for ... 针对……的治疗
H. 固定搭配：give ... the full treatment 给……全套礼遇／隆重对待

items.q: The treatment began in March and finished in June
The treatment she got was eleven weeks
not the illness but the treatment
There was no treatment for the tiredness
She received treatment at the county hospital
The treatment of the water in the village
While she was under treatment she wrote
they gave her the full treatment
The treatment she had asked for

answers.why: the treatment 意为“治疗”，治疗三月开始、六月结束，共十一周。
the treatment 意为“疗程、疗法”，她接受的疗程是十一周同样的东西，她说疗程就是一张时刻表，里面装着一个人。
the treatment 意为“对待方式、待遇”，她在意的不是病，而是别人怎么对待她：护士对邻床说话的方式、没人敲门、表格永远排在前面。
treatment for ... 意为“针对……的治疗”，没有针对那种疲倦的治疗方法。
receive treatment 意为“接受治疗”，她在四十分钟车程外的县医院接受治疗。
the treatment of the water 意为“水的处理、净化”，村里的水处理是 1931 年做的，此后没人碰过。
under treatment 意为“在接受治疗中”，她接受治疗期间写了十一封信。
give ... the full treatment 意为“给……全套礼遇、隆重对待”，1998 年他们给了她全套礼遇：门上的名字、大厅里的照片、十一个人和一篇讲话。
the treatment 意为“治疗、医治”，她记得最清楚、也是唯一道过谢的一次治疗，是医生三月里说的那十一个字。
the treatment 意为“对待方式”，她最终所求的并不是治愈，而是被当作一个人来对待。
